findings.innocent_explanation_considered: Considered that it is the same orange hologram but: 1) framing/cropping cuts it off in X1 vs full view in Y1/Y2, 2) perspective/lens and camera pan to the playback UI in X2 hides it, and most importantly 3) the subject is a hologram / screen image / visual effect (MEMORY PLAYBACK) which may legitimately change scale as part of playback.
